tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, inputs, sheets. One step above bg, always with a line border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, units, placeholder text. 4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on cards, dividers between rows, ring and bar tracks.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, secondary button outline, unchecked checkbox and radio rings. 3:1 against bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active tab marker, selected chip, progress fill. Sage on Night, near-black on Pearl.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint button fill, info badge, selected row, today cell. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on accent or bad fills.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success, goal reached, rank up, synced.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok text in badges.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning, calories badge, PR banner text.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Destructive fill and error borders. Use text-bad for error text on soft fills.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger badge and delete dialog icon.

tokens.name: text-bad
tokens.usage: Error and danger text on bad-soft. Night lightens bad to hold 4.5:1.

tokens.name: workout
tokens.usage: Workout data: banner stripe, icons, volume. Amber on Night, burnt amber on Pearl (DOMAIN base and deep).

tokens.name: nutrition
tokens.usage: Nutrition fills: protein ring, macro bars, banner stripe. Not for small text on Pearl: use text-nutrition.

tokens.name: text-nutrition
tokens.usage: Nutrition-colored text and overlines. Darker than nutrition on Pearl to hold 4.5:1.

tokens.name: cardio
tokens.usage: Cardio data: banner stripe, icons, pace.

tokens.name: sleep
tokens.usage: Sleep data and the Legend rank tier.

tokens.name: sleep-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind sleep badges.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Water, weight and steps data.

tokens.name: xp
tokens.usage: XP, trophies and favorite stars.

tokens.name: tier-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze rank text and ring. Text-safe on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: tier-silver
tokens.usage: Silver rank.

tokens.name: tier-gold
tokens.usage: Gold rank.

tokens.name: tier-elite
tokens.usage: Elite rank uses ink.

tokens.name: tier-legend
tokens.usage: Legend rank uses the sleep color.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero metric, ring center, body weight.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards in a row and inside rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge padding and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page header horizontal padding.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target. Icon buttons are 44 x 44.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary full-width call to action.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Medium buttons, tags.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, tiles, settings rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, badges, avatars, switches.
